[E7] The company's Price-to-Book (P/B) ratio stands at 1.38x, which is lower than the sector benchmark of 1.77x. [E5] The stock price sits at 37% of its historical range, suggesting it could have significant upside potential if it continues to outperform expectations or if there are positive catalysts in the market. Conceded: [E4] The absence of a dividend yield does not necessarily imply underperformance and can be seen as a strategic decision by the company.
